title: マイルCSの後に・誰もがポッシブル

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Isn't because I'm stronger. It's because I wholly believed in my possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And that's something everyone can do! I was born to show the world that, and I won to prove the power of possibility!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: After the race, Taiki asks me to race her again, but I turn her down because there's something Trainer and I need to do…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That's right! I'm going to run in a European G1! I'll be going all over the world to meet more of the Pearl family next year!
